strategy_summary: Use an explicit symmetric-function-style construction. Define a canonical recursive family h_n in the weighted polynomial ring by inverting the truncated elementary generating function. The hard step is to prove that, under the assumption Q_{A,B,d}(q) in Q[q], the specific ideal (h_{A+1},...,h_{A+d}) has finite codimension. Once that Artinianity is known, standard Cohen-Macaulay facts for weighted polynomial rings imply that h_{A+1},...,h_{A+d} is a homogeneous regular sequence, and the usual Hilbert-series formula gives back Q_{A,B,d}(q).
